deploy-bot: PROD deploy started — env=prod-us-east-1, tag=v4.0.0-rc5, commit=3f1a9c7, initiated_by=@anya :rocket:
anya: kicking this off now. will pin traffic to canary group for 10m then shift 20%/50%/100% if checks look good.
mario: noted, I'll watch telemetry and tracing for latency regressions.
jess: running quick smoke list now: auth, routing, inference pool, billing events. posting results in ~3m.
kevin: heads up — migration job `db-migrate --feature=reductions` scheduled at +5m, see runbook: https://internal/runbooks/db-reduce
deploy-bot: step=canary_deploy status=success canary_hosts=4/4
jess: canary smoke: auth ok, routing ok, inference pool 200ms p95 (baseline 180ms) — small uptick but within SLA. billing events flaky (missing a webhook) investigating.
mario: tracing shows a warmup spike from the new kernel, expected. billing webhook looks like a config mismatch on the new handler. @anya want to pause or continue?
anya: pause the rollout, hold at canary. @jess try a quick fallback of the billing handler to previous version.
jess: rolling billing handler back on canary: `kubectl set image deploy/billing billing=redwood/billing:1.12.4`
deploy-bot: rollback applied to canary billing handler, status=success
jess: re-running smoke: billing events now flowing, latency back to baseline.
mario: telemetry good, no errors in SLO dashboards.
anya: ok proceed with 20% shift in 2m, then 50/100 per checklist. notify if anything abnormal.
deploy-bot: traffic shift 20% complete — tag=v4.0.0-rc5
kevin: migration job finished cleanly, no schema changes that affect reads.
deploy-bot: traffic shift 50% complete — tag=v4.0.0-rc5
anya: all checks green from my side. proceeding to final cutover.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy complete — env=prod-us-east-1, tag=v4.0.0-rc5, commit=3f1a9c7, duration=12m16s :white_check_mark:
mario: +1 nice! logging notes for release notes: billing handler had transient regression on canary; we rolled it back and proceeded.
anya: adding release note: "Fixed billing webhook handler regression discovered during canary that was rolled back and patched before full rollout."
jess: posting final smoke summary to #incidents and closing watch window. :thumbsup:
kevin: saved canary traces and SLO snapshots to /artifacts/releases/v4.0.0-rc5/
